name: Sealskin
tagline: A self-hosted, client-server platform that enables users to run powerful, containerized desktop applications streamed directly to a web browser. It uses a browser extension to intercept user actions—such as clicking a link or downloading a file and redirects them to a secure, isolated application environment running on a remote server.
description: Sealskin is a self-hosted, client-server platform that enables users to run powerful, containerized desktop applications streamed directly to a web browser. It uses a browser extension to intercept user actions—such as clicking a link or downloading a file and redirects them to a secure, isolated application environment running on a remote server.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/sealskin:0.4.0@sha256:888dc5097fd74b445ff99c6d6c0c9d7c64b817554d855250b59dfcb2669eac30
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      HOST_URL: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8443
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8000
        published: 8000
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /storage
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/docker.sock
        target: /var/run/docker.sock
